summary: The bill eliminates D.C. firearm registration, prior-approval requirements, and feature-based restrictions, allows permitless concealed carry by eligible adults, and lets D.C. residents buy firearms directly from licensed dealers in Virginia and Maryland.

These changes directly protect and expand gun rights while preempting stricter local rules, placing the bill at the extreme positive end of the scale.
